ISO 20816-3: RMS velocity 0.60 mm/s places this machine in Zone A (Good) for machine group 2 on a rigid support. New machine condition. Vibration is excellent.

Bearing characteristic-frequency matching was not attempted: no bearing designation was supplied for this signal, so BPFO, BPFI, BSF and FTF could not be computed. Without it, a spectral peak cannot be attributed to a specific bearing element.
Re-run generate_diagnostic_report with bearing_id set to the bearing's designation (search_bearing_catalog lists the designations the bearing catalog holds).

The largest share of STFT energy is in the 2000-5000 Hz band (59% of the total). This percentage describes the measured signal and does not identify a fault. The relative distribution across frequency bands can change with the measured physical quantity (for example, acceleration versus velocity).
